what: In a list of about ten stacked big-letter names, only the row crossing the center line of the screen (row top ~ bottom straddling the center) lights up dark (1) while the rest stay faint at .1 (.1s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)). Only the paired image of the same order is shown, so the small photo beside it switches to that row’s. Hovering a row lights it before scrolling does.

options.start·end: Range where the line lights up, default ‹top center›·‹bottom center›
options.hover: If 「false」, hovering does not change it
options.--fx-dur·--fx-ease: On/off duration and curve, default .1s · cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Paired image for the row at the same index (optional) — when stacked, only the active one shows

from.where: index.html .e-mq (brand list — twelve h0 lines · dimmed line .1 · the square image beside sticks to the screen center)
